title: Hush Hour
core: Hold to tiptoe and spend breath; gently stop at a lamp; release to refill; cross sleeping lookout rings; recover keepsakes; reach home; best stars unlock practical kits
observedReferenceScope: Intro entered, foggy street/stalker/strength display inspected; no completed reference run. No copied source or media.
dedup: Rejected Hotframe due earlier time-motion game, Exquisite Corpse due Oddling Parade. Adjacent Out of Office is free route/prank/patrol play; this is a one-button breath/quiet-lamp timing corridor. No claim that stealth is an invented genre.
art: Original procedural midnight library/hotel/museum, teal and terracotta clothed human courier, navy curators, muted ivory edges and warm safe lamps; no animal mascot, Image generation or copied reference art
scope: Six finite nights in three shared sets; After Hours repeats with capped speed scaling
sdk: Guarded documented neonlib integration, real callback-only cosmetic unlocks, local fallback and optional full-envelope cloud saves; host integration not yet verified
distribution: Static local-relative files, root-index game-only ZIP, GitHub Pages
